title: Jeffrey Ketland
text: These are the webpages of Jeffrey Ketland. I am a retired Philosopher of Science. I retired in late 2025 as a Research Professor at the University of Warsaw. Prior to that, I have worked at the London School of Economics, and the Universities of Nottingham, Cambridge, Leeds, Edinburgh, Munich and Oxford. My CV can be found by the link in the sidebar.
